newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts to hover at 113-16, prop at 113-07.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts to hover at 113-16, prop at 113-07.

text.p: June gilt futures on LIFFE will pivot around the 113-16 level on Wednesday, with any significant break to the upside unlikely to be sustained in the immediate term, technical analysts said.
Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch here, said if the 113-16 level capped the market near term, gilts would likely slide to test Tuesday's low of 113-07.
Below there, the May 8 low of 112-28 would provide a further prop, he said.
By 0727 GMT, June gilts were unchanged at 113-15 after a brief move up to 113-21 earlier.
"A further correction through 113-16 would see a test of 113-24 which is the 38 percent retracement of the losses we've seen," said Branigan.
Juliette Clark at the Royal Bank of Scotland, said gilts should find good support at 113-06/07. "A bounce that builds from here should restore faith in the bull tack," she said in a note for clients.

"The longer term picture is still bullish and the consolidation that has occurred since the break up through 113-27 at the beginning of the month should now form a platform from which a new bull swing should be launched," she added.
Clark said a break of the 113-26 level would confirm the strength of the 113-07 low on Tuesday. "But be careful as the bull signals are not yet in place and the expected move higher may be delayed."
She said in that case, range trading would result with support at 113-13.
By 0742 GMT, September short sterling was down one basis point at 93.21.
